verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an integrations catalog (docs under /integrations/overview), with step-by-step pages for ticketing (Jira, ClickUp), identity (JumpCloud), and FreeAgent for offboarding and role checks, and it claims to integrate with your existing cloud stack. The evidence does not show coverage of every category in the story, and nothing documents read-only scopes. Missing for 10: documented read-only or least-privilege scopes, specific cloud-provider (AWS/GCP/Azure), code-hosting, MDM and HRIS integrations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Sprinto integrates with ClickUp ticketing system.
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
